title: Example ticket - not real data, not loaded by the tool
description: A committed sample of the on-disk format, since the real stores are gitignored and a fresh clone has no tickets to look at. It lives in docs/ rather than a tickets/ folder on purpose: the dashboard treats any folder containing tickets/ as a store, so an examples/tickets/ directory would show up alongside personal and work. test_next_task.py asserts this file carries exactly the same fields as a freshly created ticket, so it cannot quietly drift from the real shape.
